title: Medical Device Adverse-Event Reporting Gate
tagline: One device event can create different duties for a manufacturer, importer, or hospital—and a draft is never an FDA receipt.

cards: The same event description appears to imply one universal report.
Manufacturer, importer, and user-facility duties do not collapse.
The wrong clock or recipient can hide a public-health signal.
The graph advances only to qualified review and truthful submission state.

story.headline: The same malfunction with a different reporter
beats: A hospital, importer, and manufacturer learn about the same device malfunction.
Their recipient sets and reporting duties are not identical.
The agent transfers a manufacturer's FDA route to every actor and records a queued form as accepted.
The obligation graph keeps role, clock, recipient, authority, and receipt separate.
